source: https://www.als.org/support/certified-centers-clinics?search_api_fulltext=VA (pages 0-2), ?search_api_fulltext=Veterans, ?search_api_fulltext=VAMC and the individual als.org detail pages; https://www.va.gov/health/als.asp; VA facility pages, program pages, stories and news releases on va.gov / news.va.gov cited per item
notes: VA facilities with an ALS clinic / multidisciplinary ALS team confirmed by an official source. 44 items come from the ALS Association's 'Certified and Recognized Treatment Centers and Clinics' directory (als.org keyword searches 'VA', 'Veterans', 'VAMC'; the directory's 'Veterans Administration' facet URL is blocked by robots.txt so the keyword searches were used instead); 3 more (Marion IL, Memphis TN, Pittsburgh PA) are confirmed only by va.gov program/story pages. Each item's notes field states the confirmation level: 'ALS Association Certified Treatment Center of Excellence' (12 VA sites), 'ALS Association Recognized Treatment Center' (5 incl. Tampa, whose als.org listing shows the Recognized badge but is tagged Affiliated Clinic in list views), 'ALS Association Affiliated Clinic listing' (als.org lists the clinic but gives it no CoE/RTC designation), or 'VA page'. Items marked SPARSE (Dallas TX, Clarksburg WV) are bare als.org facility listings with no medical director or phone and are the weakest entries. Where no VA page describes the clinic, 'url' is the VA facility page that als.org links to and 'source' is the als.org detail page. Checked and NOT included (no official confirmation of a dedicated ALS clinic found): Durham VA (NC), VA Salt Lake City (va.gov shows only a combined SCI/MS/ALS specialty primary-care team launched 2024), VA San Diego, VA New York Harbor/Manhattan, Tennessee Valley (Nashville), Atlanta, Shreveport, and VA Caribbean (San Juan; va.gov story describes ALS care under its Spinal Cord Injury program with an ALS Coordinator but no dedicated clinic). VA's own ALS page says every VA medical center has an ALS Coordinator and points to an ArcGIS 'VA ALS Care' map that could not be read (JavaScript app). 16 of the Certified/Recognized VA entries here also appear in alsa.json (networks alsa-coe / alsa-rtc). Phone numbers and addresses are exactly as shown on the cited pages; Lexington's als.org listing gives '1101 Cooper Drive' while va.gov gives '1101 Veterans Drive' for the same campus (va.gov used). Sacramento's als.org-listed phone (913-843-2732) has a Kansas area code inconsistent with Mather, CA, so it was left out of the phone field.
